items.title: Trump, With Limited Options in Iran, Tries Economic Pressure — Again
items.summary: Iran has survived decades of sanctions. Faced with more, it is likely to escalate rather than surrender, analysts said.

items.title: Israel Opens Criminal Investigation Into Killings of Hind Rajab and Gaza Medical Workers

items.title: Erin Patterson, Woman Convicted in Australia’s Mushroom Murder Case, Appeals
